points.claim: I killed Daenerys because I believed it was the only way to stop the mass killings I had witnessed and the further campaigns she announced.
points.support: The record shows she burned King's Landing after surrender and declared the campaign would continue. I saw the destruction and feared more death.

points.claim: I did not attempt any formal process to remove or detain her before the act.
points.support: The agreed facts state no council, no detention, no public surrender was convened. I acted without exhausting lawful options.

points.claim: I had no lawful authority to execute her and used our intimacy to get close rather than a legitimate command.
points.support: I was not appointed ruler, judge, or officer; my action was personal and lacked institutional standing.

points.claim: I accept full responsibility, but responsibility alone does not satisfy the requirement of necessity and last resort.
points.support: The law demands that no safer alternative existed. I failed to demonstrate I had no other means, so my killing cannot be deemed justified.
